card.name: This/last/each before year or season
card.fires_on: Demonstrative or time words like "this", "last" and "each" placed right after a clause, where a year or season word (year, spring, summer, fall) comes next. Seen in news text about yearly counts, plans and events.

modes.label: This + season/year
modes.description: The word "this" ends a clause about an expected or planned event and is followed by year or a season.
modes.example: The DWR will conduct extensive CWD testing<< this>> fall on Utah hunting units that border Colorado

modes.label: Last/each + period
modes.description: "last" or "each" after a statistic or past event, before a year or season word.
modes.example: About 640 puppies are born<< each>> year at the facility, which opened in

card.writes: It promotes the word "year" and suppresses unrelated word pieces, so it predicts a time unit such as year next.
card.plain: It fires on "this", "last" or "each" when a word like year or spring is about to follow.
